subject.title: Show claude-swap accounts in CLI cards

question: Should enabled claude-swap automatically replace ordinary Claude CLI cards for two or more accounts, and should a claude-swap-only failure force a non-zero exit when ambient cards still succeed?
rationale: Both choices establish new user-visible CLI and scripting contracts; tests can verify an implementation but cannot decide the intended precedence or upgrade behavior.

options.title: Compatibility-first fallback
options.body: Use swap cards for successful two-plus-account inventories, but keep exit code zero when ambient output succeeds and only the optional adapter fails.

options.title: Strict integration failure
options.body: Keep the PR's non-zero exit behavior and explicitly accept that enabling claude-swap makes adapter health part of the command's success contract.

options.title: Explicit CLI opt-in
options.body: Require a dedicated cards flag or source mode before claude-swap can replace ambient output, avoiding an automatic precedence change for existing users.

recommendation.title: Compatibility-first fallback
recommendation.body: Use swap cards for successful two-plus-account inventories, but keep exit code zero when ambient output succeeds and only the optional adapter fails.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor directly requested this CLI contract decision from the repository owner, who also touched the latest PR head.
